quizName:
Hardest Questions in Alaska
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: You are upset from something at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you start driving.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you start driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, calm down before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means no. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Do not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle. Check for injuries. Call 911 if anyone is hurt. Report the crash to police if there are injuries, deaths, or damage over $1,000.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting the car in front of you?
questions.explanation: Watch for brake lights and hazards ahead. Stay four seconds behind the car in front of you. This prevents rear-end crashes.

questions.question: You are driving a friend's car that you are not familiar with. What should you do?

options.text: Do not worry about it because all cars are the same.
Do not tell your friend that you are unfamiliar with the car.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, learn where the turn signals, lights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn are. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you do not see other cars.
Signal only if there are other cars nearby.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you do not see other cars.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from a curb. Make signaling a habit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means you cannot do that action. Right turns are not allowed at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the beginning of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left that oncoming traffic has the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: You missed your exit on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Continue driving to the next exit or a safe place where you can turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to protect your brakes and prevent accidents.

questions.question: If stopped by police, what documents must you show?
questions.explanation: You must carry your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance at all times while driving. Show all three documents when a police officer asks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol harms the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, hurts your coordination, and weakens your vision and ability to judge distance. Even a small amount of alcohol makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.
